plans.title: Plans

trial.name: Free trial
trial.description: A time-limited trial of SellerHill. Not purchasable — it starts automatically when you sign up.

lite.name: Lite
lite.description: For sellers just getting started with a small catalog.

nano.name: Nano
nano.description: For testing the waters with a focused product set.

micro.name: Micro
micro.description: For solo sellers running a compact catalog.

starter.name: Starter
starter.description: For sellers with a growing catalog and steady order flow.

basic.name: Basic
basic.description: For established sellers scaling past a few thousand listings.

plus.name: Plus
plus.description: For sellers running a broad catalog across multiple niches.

growth.name: Growth
growth.description: For high-volume sellers with a five-thousand-listing catalog.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: For power sellers managing a large, actively repriced catalog.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: For professional operations running ten thousand listings.

elite.name: Elite
elite.description: For large operations with a fifteen-thousand-listing catalog.

business.name: Business
business.description: For multi-store businesses at twenty thousand listings.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: For the largest catalogs, with priority support.

scale.name: Scale
scale.description: A retired plan. Existing subscriptions keep working; new sign-ups choose from the plans above.

plans.switchDone: Your plan has been changed. Stripe will prorate the difference on your next invoice.

listings_per_month.label: Active listings
listings_per_month.description: Maximum active listings across all your stores.

amazon_orders_per_month.label: Automatic orders
amazon_orders_per_month.description: Maximum Amazon orders placed for you (automatically or linked by hand) per month.

tracking_conversions_per_month.label: Tracking conversions
tracking_conversions_per_month.description: How many shipments per month get a converted tracking number, so the buyer never sees your supplier.
